source=cn: COS first then GitHub fallback

pre-marker release retry: fill only missing binaries after verifying existing bytes
post-marker completed release retry: require the entire GitHub binary and checksum set to be present and byte-identical
existing COS same bytes: accept; existing COS conflicting bytes: block publication
stable and canary: identical mandatory mirror gate
